items.title: Color Me Badd Distance Themselves From Co-Founder Accused Of Abuse By Estranged Daughter
items.summary: The pop/R&B group Color Me Badd formed in Oklahoma City in 1985. In the early '90s, the group scored a few major hits, including "I Wanna Sex You Up," " I Adore Mi Amor ," and " All 4 Love ." Since their success faded, Color Me Badd have had a tumultuous history, with original members coming and going as they play the nostalgia circuit. The only original member in the current Color Me Badd lineup is Mark Calderon. Another original member, Kevin Thornton, originally left Color Me Badd in 1998 to become a minister in Fort Worth, Texas, though he made a couple of temporary returns in later years.

items.title: Akusmi :: Terra Incognita
items.summary: On his second album as Akusmi, Pascal Bideau mostly jettisons the short interlocking patterns of his earlier work for a wealth of wider, more colorful and free-ranging compositions. Working with several international musicians and a staggering array of eclectic instruments, Bideau has made a wide-ranging, expertly blended and comfortably eccentric album of streamlined world jazz. The territory he's exploring might not be totally unknown, but the unfamiliar and unexpected has never sounded so approachable. The post Akusmi :: Terra Incognita first appeared on Aquarium Drunkard .
